definitions: A 2018 action-adventure video game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment, based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man.
A popular video game franchise featuring the superhero Spider-Man within the Marvel universe.
examples: Marvel's Spider-Man received critical acclaim for its narrative, combat, and web-swinging mechanics.
Many fans consider Marvel's Spider-Man to be one of the best superhero games ever made.
